description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to have climate mitigation effects through forest restoration, afforestation, and sustainable forest management. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates contributions to promote environmental sustainability by financing among the largest initiatives to restore and preserve native forest in the ecologically important Cerrado biome in Brazil.

The Latin American reforestation strategy (the Strategy) was established in 2021 by the BTG Pactual Timberland Investment Group (TIG) to focus on greenfield climate-positive forestry. The geographic focus of the Strategy is Latin America, mainly Brazil and Uruguay. The Strategys objective is to protect, restore and plant trees on approximately 280,000 has of degraded land for timber production and restoration of natural forests, managing forests sustainably. Additional revenues are expected to come from carbon removal credits and manufacturing of FSC-certified wood products.
